summary: Building and maintaining a live Shopify SaaS app that lets merchants sell highly customizable neon signs, plus the admin tools behind it.
highlights: Built and maintain the frontend of Zepto Sign Customizer — a live Shopify app that lets merchants sell custom neon signs, available on the Shopify App Store.
Engineered a granular design customizer with per-character, per-word, and per-line color and font selection, significantly expanding creative options for end users.
Delivered responsive, accessible UI using Remix, Shopify Polaris, and Vanilla JS for a smooth experience across desktop and mobile storefronts.
Architected application state with Redux, managing complex cross-component data flow for the real-time design canvas.
Contributed to the merchant admin dashboard — order tracking, customization previews, and platform monitoring.
Worked across the stack regularly: bug fixes, debugging, and code reviews in Laravel / PHP / MySQL.
